name: group_commits
description: Group Conventional Commit subjects into release notes. Types feat, fix, perf, refactor and docs get the sections Added, Fixed, Changed (perf and refactor) and Documentation; a breaking change (type! or a BREAKING CHANGE subject) is listed first; chore, test, ci, build and style commits are left out and counted; any other subject goes to Other. Identical lines appear once. Fails when subjects is missing or holds more than 2000 entries.

subjects.description: Commit subjects, one string each, as printed by git log --format=%s.
